name: kich-ban-sale-chatbot
description: Dùng khi cần bien thong tin shop, danh muc san pham, chinh sach va hoi thoai inbox / binh luan that thanh KICH BAN SALE cho chatbot AI ban hang — y dinh khach, tra loi theo tung san pham (kich thuoc, chat lieu), xu ly tu choi, cau chot don, luat chuyen nhan vien, dieu cam noi, quy tac rieng cho binh luan cong khai va inbox, kem goi theo nganh hang. Xuat hai ban: doc cho nguoi (.md) va may doc (.json) de nap vao bot. Kích hoạt khi người dùng nhắc 'kich ban sale chatbot', 'kich ban chot don inbox', 'dao tao bot ban hang', 'bot tra loi binh luan hoi gia', 'hoc kich ban tu tin nhan cu', 'kho tri thuc cho chatbot'. Không dùng cho — tai lieu ban hang va pipeline cho nguoi ban that thi dung skill aibiz-sales-enablement; giong thuong hieu thi dung skill brand-voice; goi ban, bonus, khuyen mai thi dung skill offer-design; cai dat kenh, noi bot, auto-reply thi dung skill thiet-lap-kenh.
